# binary

The `pgbouncer-binary` dependency — see the parent's [`CLAUDE.md`](../../CLAUDE.md) for how the start script runs it and how a version switch happens.

A plugin of its own on purpose: a `deps/` barrel is a shipped runtime, so declaring it in `database/pgbouncer` itself made every composition reaching the database plugins (the public website included) carry `infra/deps` whole. Only the start script (a leaf `scripts/` file) and the deps registry import this one.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The pgbouncer-binary dependency: an infra/deps package copy of this platform's @equin/pgbouncer package outside the checkout, pinned (holder machine-pgbouncer) — the start script runs the pinned install, switched only by ./equin deps pin pgbouncer-binary. A child of its own so no composition's closure reaches the deps engine through the database plugins.
- Deps:
  - Uses:
    - `infra/deps.defineDep`
    - `infra/deps/package-copy.npmPackageCopy`
  - Exports (values): `pgbouncerBinary`
